{{Quote|I'm sorry I didn't make the funeral, Han. Some of my people got trapped near Obroa-skai when the Vong took it. I couldn't leave them hanging.|Lando Calrissian|<ref name="EoVII">''[[The New Jedi Order: Edge of Victory II: Rebirth]]''</ref>}}
The '''funeral of Chewbacca''' took place on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], six [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] [[Death/Legends|died]] in the [[destruction of Sernpidal]].

==History==
[[File:Sernpidalian.jpg|thumb|left|Chewbacca ushering citizens to safety.]]
In order to draw [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Starship/Legends|ships]] into an ambush, [[Nom Anor]] suggested to [[Prefect/Legends|Prefect]] [[Da'Gara]] that the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] should destroy [[Sernpidal/Legends|Sernpidal]]. Da'Gara decided to use the [[Yo'gand's Core]] tactic, and bring Sernpidal's [[Moon/Legends|moon]], [[Dobido]], down into the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] using a [[dovin basal]]'s . [[Anakin Solo]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] were on Sernpidal doing a favor for [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]], and attempted to evacuate as many [[Sernpidalian|citizens]] as possible. After bringing an unconscious [[Anakin Solo]] back to the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], the strong winds caused by the moon entering the atmosphere knocked [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] down. While [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] was at the landing ramp in order to grab Chewie, Anakin was piloting the ''Falcon''. As the moon came closer to the planet Anakin had to make a judgment call, and in order to save as many people as possible, he lifted off before Chewie was aboard. Chewie stood behind as the planet was [[Destruction of Sernpidal|destroyed]], and defiantly roared at the moon, having sacrificed his life so that others may live.<ref name="VP">''[[The New Jedi Order: Vector Prime]]''</ref>

[[File:Chewbacca_Dies.jpg|thumb|right|Chewbacca's death on Sernpidal.]]

Six [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after the destruction of Sernpidal, Chewie's closest family members and friends gathered around a circular table on the outskirts of [[Rwookrrorro/Legends|Rwookrrorro]] on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] to honor his death. [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] could not attend because he was involved in a [[First Battle of Obroa-skai|battle near]] [[Obroa-skai/Legends|Obroa-skai]],<ref name="EoVII" /> and [[Mara Jade Skywalker]] was on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] because her illness had worsened. Since Sernpidal was completely destroyed, and its debris was being used to feed a [[Koros-Strohna|worldship]], his body could not be recovered, and a proper [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Funeral/Legends|funeral]] could not be performed.<ref name="AoCI" />

[[Ralrracheen]], however, gave a moving eulogy in [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]], which was very rare among Wookiees. He detailed Chewie's quest to the [[Shadowlands/Legends|Shadow Forest]] with his friend, [[Salporin/Legends|Salporin]], and described how he had killed a [[quillarat]] for his bride, [[Mallatobuck/Legends|Malla]].

Ralrra also described many of Chewie's adventures with Han, from his [[Slavery/Legends|enslavement]] under the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] and his [[Life debt/Legends|life debt]] to Han for freeing him, to Chewie aiding in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], and later the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].

After the eulogy, the mourners ate some of the food displayed on the table, such as [[barbecued trakkrrrn ribs]], [[Salad/Legends|salads]] with [[Rillrrnnn/Legends|Rillrrnnn]] seeds, [[forest-honey cake]]s, and various beverages. Malla gave Han Chewie's first [[Bowcaster/Legends|bowcaster]], and [[Lumpawaroo/Legends|Lumpawaroo]] gave Han his father's carry pouch. [[Attichitcuk/Legends|Attichitcuk]] also informed Han that [[Lowbacca]] and Waroo were going to carry out Chewie's life debt.<ref name="AoCI" />
